item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
Fixed

  • Panel appearance no longer breaks in Dark Mode — the outer panel background now matches the system theme correctly instead of staying stuck light.
  • Fixed the popover panel unexpectedly closing when opening Activity History (and the window flashing shut again on reopen).
  • Fixed the awake-mode tabs (Off / AI Active / Always) not filling the full width of their row.
  • Switching between Off / AI Active / Always no longer shifts the cards below it up or down.

Added

  • New Appearance setting (Settings → General): Light / Dark / Auto, defaults to Auto (follows system, same as before).
  • Awake-mode tabs now show a short explanation of what the selected mode does.
  • Activity History entries are now grouped by day and collapsible, one day open at a time.

Changed

  • "While AI is active" mode shortened to "AI Active" in the tab label (full meaning now shown underneath instead).

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
✨ Added

  • Uninstall UnIdle… in Settings › General puts your Mac back the way it was — sleep settings, Claude Code hooks, login item, permissions and settings — then moves UnIdle to the Trash. Your licence key is copied to the clipboard and this Mac's slot is freed, so you can use it again.
  • Sessions are grouped by agent, and every session shows its project name (e.g. Claude Code › billing-v2, api).
  • Setup now explains why each permission is needed and how to revoke it.

🔧 Changed

  • Lid-close on battery now uses a small helper installed with one standard macOS password prompt — no more "Apple could not verify this script" warning. Restore and Uninstall need no password.
  • A shut lid is held awake only while an agent is actually working, even in Always mode. With nothing running, the Mac sleeps as usual.
  • Updating from 0.1.1 (build 9) or later keeps every permission. Coming from an older version? Re-add UnIdle once in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility.
  • If you used lid-close before, set it up once more in Settings › Power — the old password rule is no longer used.

🐛 Fixed

  • No more Keychain password prompts — the licence key is no longer stored in the Keychain.
  • Sessions now always get their project name; a broken start hook used to leave it blank.
  • The panel shrinks back to fit after switching to the Windowed layout.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
✨ Added

  • The Activity Log records every lid close — whether UnIdle kept the Mac awake (and for which agent), or why it slept: no agent working, Always mode with nothing running, Pro needed, or lid-close switched off.
  • It also logs when the Mac slept and woke, and when the lid was opened.
  • Entries now show the agent and project, e.g. "Awake — Claude Code · billing-v2 running".

🐛 Fixed

  • Your licence key is kept after updating to 0.1.3. It's moved out of the Keychain silently, so Uninstall and Deactivate free this Mac's slot again. No password prompts.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description:
UnIdle 0.1.5

Fixed

  • Finished alerts now show the start of Claude's actual reply instead of "Ready for your next prompt", including long, multi-paragraph replies.
  • Deactivate this device works again: it now confirms inside the Manage popover.
  • One Claude Code session no longer shows up as two rows in Live Sessions.
  • Without hooks, activity detection counts tool calls and real work, and only watches each session's own project folder.

Changed

  • Every alert names the project: "<project> — finished", "— needs permission" or "— has a question".
  • Questions from Claude get their own alert with the question text.
  • Claude Code hooks are always on. To remove them, use Settings › General › Disconnect from Claude Code.

Added

  • Gift Pro and one-click activation links from the license email.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.6
item.description:
UnIdle 0.1.6

Changed

  • Phone alerts now carry only the project and what happened ("my-app — finished"). Claude's replies, commands and questions stay on your Mac, never on the public relay.
  • A Pro license works on one Mac. To move it, deactivate it on the old Mac first (Pro › Manage).

Added

  • Copy license key in Pro › Manage, without showing it on screen.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.7
item.description:
UnIdle 0.1.7

Fixed

  • Activating from the email link no longer says "You're Pro" and then drops back to Free: if a key is already on two Macs, you now see that straight away, with how to free one.

Changed

  • A Pro license works on two of your own Macs, and the message says so.
  • The version number also shows at the bottom of the Settings page, and only once on the main page.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.8
item.description:
UnIdle 0.1.8

Fixed

  • Pasting a license key and clicking Activate now shows the result: "You are Pro", or why it was refused (for example, the key is already on two Macs). Before, the popover just closed.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.9
item.description:
New

  • Off, AI Active and Always are now tabs, with what each one does right under them.
  • "Lock screen & walk away" says what happens: the screen locks, the display sleeps, your agents keep working.
  • After 3 hours in Always, UnIdle offers to switch back to AI Active, so your Mac can sleep tonight.
  • Every (i) now opens a short explanation when you click it.

Better

  • Setup has a clear step-by-step bar, opens centred, and stays in front while you finish it.
  • "Deactivate at" fits on one line.
  • Plan shows as Plan: Pro, Plan: Free or Plan: Trial with the days left.

Removing UnIdle

  • Dragged UnIdle to the Trash? Its lid-close helper and Claude Code hooks now remove themselves. Settings › Uninstall UnIdle still removes everything at once.
  • Reinstalling shows the setup again. Your Pro license is kept.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.10
item.description:
Changed

  • Always's end time now sits in the Always tab: "Ends at [time]". AI Active already ends by itself once your agents are done.
  • Every Pro feature is free to try for 7 days. A trial you already started keeps its 14 days.
  • One panel layout for everyone: the Windowed / All-in-one choice is gone.

Fixed

  • An end time after midnight (for example 01:16) no longer keeps Always paused for the whole day.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.11
item.description:
Fixed

  • Right after UnIdle starts or updates, an agent that has been open for hours (like the Codex built into the ChatGPT app) no longer shows as running or keeps your Mac awake. It counts again as soon as it actually works.
  • All settings now has the same margins as the main panel.

Changed

  • Keep display on has an (i) that explains it: off lets the display sleep and lock as usual while your agents keep running.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.12
item.description:
Fixed

  • Onboarding no longer shows again after an update that installed itself while your Mac restarted.
  • Closing the welcome window with the red button now counts as Skip setup, so it doesn't come back at the next launch.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.
